description: Query oil refineries from OpenStreetMap (canonical refinery tags only — petroleum_refinery, oil_refinery, refinery). ~700 facilities globally, each with name, operator, product, capacity (when tagged), country, city. Use for questions like "refineries in Saudi Arabia", "oil refining capacity on the Gulf Coast", "European refineries near Russian crude pipelines". Pass country to slice (ISO2 code or country name).

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 (e.g. "SA") or country-name substring (e.g. "Saudi"). Filter optional.

name: query_refineries
